findings.statement: CA9 is up in tumour at RNA (log2FC 6.312) and protein (log2FC 2.269), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 9.712) and survives purity extrapolation (RNA log2FC at purity 1: 7.787). Antibody drugs exist (girentuximab, PHASE_3).

CD70 is up in tumour (RNA log2FC 4.464, protein log2FC 2.421), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 7.09) and stays high at purity 1 (4.278), so it is tumour-cell intrinsic. Clinical-stage anti-CD70 agents exist (cusatuzumab PHASE_2, vorsetuzumab mafodotin PHASE_1).
ENPP3 is a membrane enzyme up in tumour (RNA log2FC 3.895, protein log2FC 1.544), TCGA-KIRC log2FC 5.557, purity-1 RNA log2FC 5.278. The ADC AGS-16C3F reached PHASE_2.

SCARB1 is the top-ranked target-profile gene (rank 1, score 4.1314). RNA log2FC 2.974, protein log2FC 1.837, TCGA-KIRC log2FC 3.989, purity-1 RNA log2FC 3.762. It is not prognostic in TCGA (Cox log HR -0.038).

SLC16A3 (lactate transporter) is up in tumour (RNA log2FC 3.435, protein log2FC 2.279), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC 3.291 and purity-1 RNA log2FC 3.821. Its copy-number vs expression correlation is positive (cis rho 0.258).

NNMT is up in tumour (RNA log2FC 4.67, protein log2FC 2.709), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 4.685), and higher expression predicts worse survival (Cox log HR 0.301, padj 0.00479). It is rank 2 in the biomarker profile.
HK2 (glycolysis) is up in tumour (RNA log2FC 3.351, protein log2FC 2.106), TCGA-KIRC log2FC 3.974, purity-1 RNA log2FC 3.989. This fits the Warburg-like state that follows VHL loss.

PSAT1 is down in tumour (RNA log2FC -3.867, protein log2FC -1.963). It is rank 1 in the biomarker profile, replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC -2.974), and its expression is prognostic (Cox log HR 0.43, padj 5.66e-7).

ALDH6A1 is down in tumour (RNA log2FC -3.399, protein log2FC -1.925) and sits on a lost region (CNV loss frequency 0.355; cis rho 0.525). Lower expression predicts worse survival (Cox log HR -0.554), consistent with loss of normal tubule identity.

SLC22A8 (proximal tubule transporter) is strongly down (RNA log2FC -6.715, protein log2FC -2.264), TCGA-KIRC log2FC -6.154. Lower expression predicts worse survival (Cox log HR -0.402), so it is a tubule-identity biomarker rather than a target.

ALDOB is down in tumour (RNA log2FC -7.028, protein log2FC -2.273), TCGA-KIRC log2FC -4.741, with CNV loss frequency 0.164 and cis rho 0.331. Lower expression predicts worse survival (Cox log HR -0.358).
PBRM1 is recurrently mutated (freq 0.362, 185 of 511 tumours, padj 4.59e-239) and sits on 3p with CNV loss frequency 0.8, which explains the 3p-loss driver mechanism of ccRCC.

VHL RNA is modestly lower in tumour (log2FC -0.479, padj 1.62e-17) and protein log2FC is -0.172. It is flagged non-significant by the effect-size threshold, so VHL acts through 3p loss and mutation, not through a large expression change.

caveats: Protein fold changes are modest compared with RNA because TMT ratios are compressed.
Only 16 to 17 tumour/normal pairs were available for some protein tests, such as VHL.
DepMap ccRCC effects are near zero for most top up-regulated genes, so dependency is not supported. Targetability rests on surface or ADC accessibility.
Immune genes such as FCGR3A and FCER1G are infiltration-driven (purity rho -0.65 and -0.692) and were not reported as tumour targets.
This is bulk data, and the ranking is association-based, not causal.
